newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson signs $66 million deal in Russia.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson signs $66 million deal in Russia.

text.p: Swedish telecommunications group Telefon AB L.M. Ericsson said Wednesday it had signed a $66-million contract with a Russian company to supply switching equipment for the Moscow city network.
Ericsson said in a statement it would suppply telecommunications operator AO MGST with AXE switching and other equipment in 1997 and 1998.
AO MGTS, the Moscow city network public operator, is the largest operator of fixed telecommunications networks in Russia, it added.
The Swedish group won the contract through Ericsson Corporation AO, which is based in Moscow with offices in St. Petersburg.
